description: Nova Scotia Topographic DataBase - Buildings (Point Layer) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Part of the Nova Scotia Topographic Database (NSTDB), the buildings theme layer is updated and maintained from aerial photography. Buildings over 30m (one side) are collected as polygons, all others as points. Coverage: Government of Nova Scotia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Its tags are building, home, construction, hospital, school. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-10-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Nova Scotia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
